en: An evolved Alpha Zombie which can spawn large groups of powerful blood and flying zombies. It spawns pure strain zombies when rooted.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，能生成大批强大的鲜血僵尸和飞行僵尸。扎根时会生成纯株系僵尸。

en: An evolved Alpha Zombie which flies, detects cloaked units and plants parasites in security units. It is only vulnerable to mining charges and motion sensors.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，能飞行、侦测隐形单位并在安保单位体内植入寄生虫。它仅能被采矿炸药和运动传感器伤害。

en: An evolved Alpha Zombie which leaves creep wherever it moves while passively toughening nearby zombies, but has no attack.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，移动时会在沿途留下菌毯，同时被动强化附近的僵尸，但没有攻击能力。

en: An evolved Alpha Zombie with devastating melee and short-range attacks and a hard, regenerating carapace.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，拥有毁灭性的近战和短程攻击，以及坚硬、可再生的甲壳。

en: An evolved Alpha Zombie with greatly increases speed on creep, good at hunting down players.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，在菌毯上速度大幅提升，擅长猎杀玩家。

en: An evolved Alpha Zombie with long-range line attacks with spines and the ability to summon strong locusts. It uses energy to attack and cannot attack enemies right next to it.
zh: 一种进化后的阿尔法僵尸，能用尖刺进行远程直线攻击，并能召唤强大的蝗虫。它消耗能量攻击，无法攻击紧贴身边的敌人。

en: Aberrations are durable units that deal heavy damage. They cannot be stunned by flashbangs, only slowed down, and are able to walk over smaller zombies.
zh: 畸变体是耐久单位，能造成大量伤害。它们不会被闪光弹眩晕，只会被减速，并且能够踩过较小的僵尸。

en: Access the sub-level through a mining shaft. Robots take longer than marines to access the sub-level.
zh: 通过采矿竖井进入地下层。机器人进入地下层比陆战队员耗时更长。

en: Alpha Zombies are powerful mutated zombies with especially high life and unique abilities. Alpha zombies must first be formed inside a cocoon, and if not killed they will hatch to fight alongside the horde. So far 5 types of alpha zombies have been identified:<n/><n/><c val="0000FF">Aberration:</c> serves as a tank with extremely high life and powerful attacks<n/><c val="8000FF">Geneweaver:</c> summons evolved forms of zombies to add to the horde, vulnerable while taking damage<n/><c val="00FF00">Anubalisk:</c> strikes with subterranean spines to slowly kill its enemies from far away<n/><c val="FF0000">Legion Zombie:</c> provides buffs to nearby zombies, strengthening the horde, also spreads creep wherever it goes<n/><c val="FF8000">Hunter:</c> Moves quickly on creep and inflicts poison with attacks, also can blind players<n/><c val="FFFF00">Oculus:</c> flying zombie that can scout its enemies, its evolved form can launch micro parasites which weaken opponents
zh: 阿尔法僵尸是强大的变异僵尸，拥有极高的生命值和独特的能力。阿尔法僵尸必须先在茧中成形，如果没有被杀死，它们就会孵化出来与僵尸群并肩作战。目前已识别出 5 种阿尔法僵尸：<n/><n/><c val="0000FF">畸变体：</c>充当坦克，拥有极高的生命值和强大的攻击<n/><c val="8000FF">织基因者：</c>召唤僵尸的进化形态加入僵尸群，受到伤害时较为脆弱<n/><c val="00FF00">阿努巴利斯克：</c>用地底尖刺从远处缓慢地杀死敌人<n/><c val="FF0000">军团僵尸：</c>为附近的僵尸提供增益，强化僵尸群，走到哪里都会蔓延菌毯<n/><c val="FF8000">猎手：</c>在菌毯上移动迅速，攻击附带毒素，还能致盲玩家<n/><c val="FFFF00">眼魔：</c>会飞行的僵尸，可以侦察敌人，其进化形态能发射微型寄生虫削弱对手

I craved the strength and certainty of steel. I aspired to the purity of the blessed machine."<n/>                 --Sgt. Dominus</c>
